name: agentfeedback
description: The AgentFeedback plugin: teaches coding agents to report friction (missing docs, misbehaving tools, stale config) to AgentFeedback, kept in a local database or sent to a server.

plugins.name: agentfeedback
plugins.description: Report friction from your coding agent to AgentFeedback, kept in a local database or sent to a server: the agentfeedback skill, which files reports with the agentfeedback binary (the skill's scripts/install.sh installs it).
